text: Refines D-0197 for #570: CI runs internal/verify's and internal/plumbing's tests together in invariant/verify-tests' four shards, through .github/shard-tests.sh, and the unit-test step leaves both packages out. internal/plumbing's unit tests had grown from 301 to 392 seconds before #546 to 544.5 seconds on main at 9e2ba1d, unsharded, and #564's next steps each add real-process Go acceptance tests to it. #569 adds about five minutes, on a Mac, of gate tests to internal/verify, whose two shards already took 6 to 9 minutes. Four shards keep each well inside its 20-minute timeout. Built by hand, since the factory can't edit .github/.
